title: Alt does not suppress Shift/Ctrl additive selection when releasing over a selected shape
reason: Reports tldraw applying different additive-selection modifier rules on pointer release depending on the release target. No comments were available.
assessment: Varve latches pointer modifiers for a gesture and uses selectionOperationFromModifiers for selection changes. This report is specifically a down-versus-up modifier inconsistency in tldraw; no matching Varve release branch has been reproduced.

varveAssessment.assessment: Varve latches pointer modifiers for a gesture and uses selectionOperationFromModifiers for selection changes. This report is specifically a down-versus-up modifier inconsistency in tldraw; no matching Varve release branch has been reproduced.

title: Malformed deep links move the camera to the origin instead of falling back
reason: Reports malformed serialized viewport links reaching camera update with invalid coordinates rather than the documented fallback. Missing parameter behavior is separately a design question. No comments were available.
assessment: Varve's navigation target parser validates viewport zoom and pan values and returns a structured invalid-target result for malformed links; existing navigationTargets tests cover malformed and hostile input. No invalid camera fallback path matching this report was found.

varveAssessment.assessment: Varve's navigation target parser validates viewport zoom and pan values and returns a structured invalid-target result for malformed links; existing navigationTargets tests cover malformed and hostile input. No invalid camera fallback path matching this report was found.

title: Follow tooltip says Following, Windows shortcuts mix Ctrl and Shift, and shortcuts preference only disables some keys
reason: Combines a hosted follow tooltip, Windows glyph formatting, and inconsistent effects from tldraw's keyboard-shortcut preference. No comments were available.
assessment: Varve has no follow/collaboration control or matching global shortcuts-disable preference. Its shortcut reference and platform labels are built from Varve's own shortcut model, so this combined upstream report does not identify a shared failure path.

varveAssessment.assessment: Varve has no follow/collaboration control or matching global shortcuts-disable preference. Its shortcut reference and platform labels are built from Varve's own shortcut model, so this combined upstream report does not identify a shared failure path.

title: Drawings are lost when /develop and another example share the example persistence key
reason: Reports two tldraw example routes sharing one browser persistence key while registering incompatible schemas, causing one-way sync and document overwrite. No comments were available.
assessment: Varve's document tabs and local persistence do not share this example-route persistenceKey/schema-migration arrangement, and there is no corresponding cross-tab document synchronization path to reproduce.

varveAssessment.assessment: Varve's document tabs and local persistence do not share this example-route persistenceKey/schema-migration arrangement, and there is no corresponding cross-tab document synchronization path to reproduce.

title: Hard reset deletes every tldraw document on the origin without confirmation and stalls when another tab is open
reason: Reports an origin-wide destructive database reset without confirmation and an IndexedDB connection-blocking stall. No comments were available.
assessment: The described debug-menu hard reset and shared tldraw database registry are specific to upstream developer examples; this does not establish a matching Varve user-flow or storage deletion path.

varveAssessment.assessment: The described debug-menu hard reset and shared tldraw database registry are specific to upstream developer examples; this does not establish a matching Varve user-flow or storage deletion path.

title: Create 100 shapes reuses ids after a reload and marks no stopping point
reason: Reports a tldraw developer menu fixture command reusing deterministic ids without an undo boundary or viewport-aware placement. No comments were available.
assessment: Varve has no equivalent create-100-shapes debug menu action; the fixture command's id, undo, and viewport-placement defects do not map to a current user workflow.

varveAssessment.assessment: Varve has no equivalent create-100-shapes debug menu action; the fixture command's id, undo, and viewport-placement defects do not map to a current user workflow.

title: Turning keyboard shortcuts off also removes the way out of focus mode
reason: Reports a global disable preference suppressing both editing and recovery shortcuts while the dialog still presents them as active. No comments were available.
assessment: Varve does not expose the same global keyboard-shortcuts enable/disable preference or focus-mode escape dependency, so the reported inaccessible recovery route has no matching setting path.

varveAssessment.assessment: Varve does not expose the same global keyboard-shortcuts enable/disable preference or focus-mode escape dependency, so the reported inaccessible recovery route has no matching setting path.

title: Color scheme and reduce motion follow the operating system only some of the time
reason: Combines stale pre-mount system theme, non-reactive OS reduced-motion preference, and a shortcut that replaces System theme with explicit Light/Dark. No comments were available.
assessment: Varve's theme runtime subscribes to live OS color-scheme and contrast changes while System is selected, and reduced-motion behavior has its own runtime manager; its theme control and shortcuts do not share the described tldraw paths. The specific three-part upstream regression is not established locally.

title: IndexedDB read-failure alert promises a reload that never happens
reason: Reports a tldraw IndexedDB read failure showing a reload promise without actually reloading; the write-failure path reloads. No comments were available.
assessment: Varve's storage recovery path is handled through its persistence/lifecycle and backup service rather than the referenced TLLocalSyncClient alert flow. No corresponding read-failure message/action mismatch was demonstrated from this upstream report.
